Petrel / Petrelgram — deletion dissolve animation
Source: https://github.com/miramira8295/Petrel
Revision: ed218f4559cf083b51b08c5bf0bb27ea6215cbb9
Authors: miramira8295 and Petrel contributors
License: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE.txt)

RecordDissolveEffect.ets and cpp/record_dissolve adapt the fragment subdivision,
wavefront, motion and fade algorithm from ShatterCanvasFallback.ets and the native
shatter_renderer.cpp/.h, shatter_geometry.h and shatter_shaders.h implementation.
Local changes: independent NAPI module, ArkUI V2, bounded single-row snapshot and
particles, async pixel preparation, NativeVSync-driven GPU instancing, capture and
render timeouts, opacity fallback, resize/disposal cleanup, list collapse,
automatic-height bookshelf cards, visible-item batch budgets and per-animation
render timing summaries. No ArkTS per-frame Canvas drawing remains.
